now: Peggy wakes in the present and learns the Hydra Stomper is Steve, kept by the Red Room.
proposed: Peggy and Natasha find Steve inside the Hydra Stomper, brainwashed by the Red Room, and he gives his life to destroy it.
changes.evidence: Peggy does not wake in #14: she came out of the Tesseract portal into the present back in #1 and is already on a S.H.I.E.L.D. mission. In #14 she and Natasha find Steve inside the Hydra Stomper aboard the Lemurian Star; the Red Room captured and brainwashed him, and he sacrifices himself to destroy the Red Room.

now: In Old Hollywood, Agatha stars in Howard Stark's Cosmic Queen while plotting to drain the Celestial buried in Earth, and Kingo talks her out of it.
proposed: In Old Hollywood, Agatha stars in Howard Stark's Cosmic Queen while plotting to drain Tiamut, the Celestial buried in Earth. She takes its power to defeat Arishem, then Kingo talks her into giving it up.
changes.evidence: Kingo does not talk her out of the plan: with Stark and Jarvis's help Agatha takes Kingo's and Tiamut's powers and becomes a Celestial; after defeating Arishem, Kingo convinces her to give up the Celestial power and join him in the movie business.

now: Ultron gives up on destroying his universe, joins Peggy's team against the Watchers and dies saving them.
proposed: Ultron, regretting that he wiped out all life in his universe, joins Peggy's team against the Watchers and dies saving them.
changes.evidence: In #25 this Ultron has already destroyed all life in his universe, eons earlier; he says he realized there is no peace without life and that extinguishing it was a mistake, then agrees to help rescue Carter and the Watcher. In #26 he sacrifices himself to buy them time. He doesn't give up on destroying his universe, because he already did it.

now: Kamala, Kate, Yelena and Riri fight their way across a ruined Earth while Wanda rules the dead.
proposed: Kamala, Kate and Riri set out across a ruined Earth while Wanda rules the dead, and only Kamala lives to reach Yelena's group in Ohio.
changes.evidence: Kamala travels with Kate, Riri and F.R.I.D.A.Y., not Yelena. Kate is killed by zombie Carol Danvers and Riri sacrifices herself on the way; Blade Knight brings Kamala to the North Institute in Ohio, where she meets Melina, Alexei and Yelena. The four named never travel together.

now: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis flee across the galaxy, from Las Vegas to Knowhere and Jotunheim, to protect their unhatched egg.
proposed: Howard the Duck and Darcy Lewis chase their stolen egg across the galaxy, from the Grandmaster's cruise to Knowhere and Jotunheim, as every power in the Nine Realms tries to claim it.
changes.evidence: They don't start in Las Vegas (the Las Vegas party is #7). In #22 they join the Grandmaster's cruise, Yondu steals the egg, and they pursue it to Knowhere, where Kaecilius has it. They then take it to Loki on Jotunheim, where Laufey, Zeus, Malekith and Thanos's Black Order all go after it.

proposed: The Watcher takes Peggy from a mission aboard the Lemurian Star into the Guardians of the Multiverse. Back home, she and Natasha find the Hydra Stomper armor with someone inside.
changes.evidence: The Watcher recruits Captain Carter while she infiltrates Batroc's ship, the Lemurian Star, in her universe. After Ultron's defeat she is sent home, and in the mid-credits scene she and her universe's Black Widow find the Hydra Stomper armor on Batroc's ship. This also covers the lead A:by-natasha-carter:0 (#9) to carter.

proposed.happens_at: strange|multi| (the Sanctum Infinitum and the Forge), What If...?#18. The line's Carter's-world part (freeing Steve from the Red Room) is #14 and its 1602 part is #17, and both already have entries at carter and y1602. The #18 tag doesn't fit those places.

changes.evidence: In #18 Strange Supreme takes Carter to the Sanctum Infinitum, where she and Kahhori bring down the Forge. The Watcher then takes her to Strange's restored universe. The Red Room arc is #14 and the 1602 incursion is #17.

proposed.happens_at: strange|multi|, What If...?#18. Carter stops the 1602 incursion in #17, which already has an entry here.

changes.evidence: Carter stops the incursion and is met by Strange Supreme at the end of #17. Everything in #18 happens at Strange Supreme's Sanctum Infinitum and in his restored universe.

proposed: Strange Supreme helps the Watcher gather the Guardians of the Multiverse. Afterwards he keeps watch over Killmonger and Zola, sealed in a pocket dimension, in his own ruined universe.
changes.evidence: The Watcher (who fled to Strange Supreme's universe at the end of #8) recruits the team with Strange. After the fight, Strange encapsulates Zola and Killmonger in a pocket dimension, the Watcher teleports him back home, and Strange assigns himself to watch the bubble. This covers leads A:by-guardians-multiverse:1, T:by-killmonger:2, T:by-arnim-zola:1 and T:by-strange-supreme:1 (all #9 to strange).

proposed: Now the living soul of his restored universe, Strange strips the Eminence, the Incarnate and the Executioner of their power.
changes.evidence: Carter carries her team to Strange Supreme's universe, where Strange, now the universe's sentient consciousness, removes the three Watchers' powers. The file T:by-strange-supreme:4 points here, but the place has no S3 entry.

proposed: Now Nova Prime, Nebula leads the Nova Corps against a monster attacking Xandar, and Captain Carter's Guardians help her bring it down.
changes.evidence: A cosmic squid monster attacks Xandar while Nova Prime Nebula coordinates the Nova Corps. Captain Carter, Kahhori, Byrdie and Storm arrive and help defeat it, and Nebula thanks them for saving her world.

proposed: The Watcher takes Gamora into the Guardians of the Multiverse as she and Tony melt down the Infinity Gauntlet with Eitri, and later returns her to him.
changes.evidence: In #9 the Watcher abducts this universe's Gamora as she melts the Infinity Gauntlet with Iron Man and Eitri. At the end she reunites with Iron Man. (The ep tag for this line is #9; if the file line actually describes the Sakaar race, that is #13 and already has an entry here.)

proposed: The Watcher pulls Killmonger out of Wakanda just as Pepper, Shuri and the Dora Milaje close in, taking him into the Guardians of the Multiverse.
changes.evidence: The Watcher abducts Erik Killmonger in Wakanda, just as Pepper Potts, Shuri and the Dora Milaje close in on him. (The killmonger place is not in this batch.)

proposed: The Watcher brings Natasha from Ultron's ruined world here, and she steals Loki's scepter and subdues him with it.
changes.evidence: Unable to restore Black Widow's world, the Watcher places her in the universe where the Avengers were assassinated, as Fury, Captain Marvel and Captain America fight Loki. She steals the Scepter and uses it to subdue him. (The pymworld place is not in this batch.)

proposed.happens_at: strange|multi| (Strange Supreme's Sanctum Infinitum), What If...?#18. The line's Kahhori's-world part (Tesseract power, the conquistadors) is #15, which already has an entry here.

changes.evidence: In #18 Kahhori helps Carter bring down Strange Supreme's Forge at the Sanctum Infinitum. Only afterwards does the Watcher return her home. She gains her power and drives out the conquistadors in #15.

owner_calls.question: The S3 Ultron is a different variant: per #25 Carter seeks out one of the many Ultrons who never heard the Watcher, who wiped out life in his own universe. Should his entry stay at 'Ultron's world' (the #8 reality, whose Ultron left for the multiverse and was sealed away in #9)?
options: Keep it here (same kind of world)
Move it to a separate 'another Ultron's world' place
Drop the place mention and keep it only on the file
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom calls him 'Reflective Infinity Ultron', a separate variant; Storm notes there are many Ultron variants who never got to hear the Watcher, and Carter goes to the universe where that Ultron destroyed all life.

owner_calls.question: Nebula's Xandar is called Earth-625 in What If...? #25. Should the region line give that number instead of 'Another reality'?
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia's #25 summary: the team stops a universe-eater 'from attacking Earth-625', which a footnote identifies as the universe of 'What If... Nebula Joined the Nova Corps?'. The MCU fandom files Nebula under 'Nebula/Earth-625'.
